views.body_sql:
SELECT
  s.cust_id,
  c.cust_city,
  s.prod_id,
  p.prod_name,
  s.time_id,
  s.promo_id,
  s.quantity_sold,
  s.amount_sold
FROM sales s
JOIN customers c ON s.cust_id = c.cust_id
JOIN products p ON s.prod_id = p.prod_id
